greek_carving.agape: ἀγάπη — unconditional, self-giving, directed act (not feeling)

lineage: Hebrew אהב (ahav) — Septuagint chose ἀγαπάω as carrier verb
Koine ἀγάπη — rare secular, became Christian technical term
Latin caritas — dignity transferred, then narrowed to alms
Old French charité → English charity — semantic narrowing
Modern English 'love' — fourfold collapse into one polysemous word

hypothesis.method: Track agape_score of the love-word per language per century
hypothesis.forkable: Adopters may reject Axiom 0 and seed a different anchor

payload.axiom_0_declaration: ἀγάπη (agape) is an untranslatable loanword; English lacks a single equivalent. Anchor is human-decided origin, not derived measurement. Forking with a different anchor is permitted — chains diverge at genesis.
